text: When the bell struck one. <break time="0.8s" /> The first spirit appeared. <break time="0.8s" /> Beside Scrooges bed. <break time="0.8s" /> It was a strange figure. <break time="0.8s" /> Like a child and an old man. <break time="0.8s" /> At the same time. <break time="0.8s" /> A bright, clear light shone. <break time="0.8s" /> From the top of its head. <break time="0.8s" /> I am the Ghost of Christmas Past. <break time="0.8s" /> It said. <break time="0.8s" /> Your past. <break time="0.8s" /> The spirit took him back. <break time="0.8s" /> To the school where he had spent lonely Christmases as a boy. <break time="0.8s" /> Scrooge saw his younger self. <break time="0.8s" /> Reading alone. <break time="0.8s" /> And he began to cry. <break time="0.8s" /> Next, they visited old Mister Fezziwig. <break time="0.8s" /> Who had been Scrooges kind master. <break time="0.8s" /> Fezziwig gave a happy Christmas party. <break time="0.8s" /> And everyone danced until eleven oclock. <break time="0.8s" /> The happiness he gives. <break time="0.8s" /> Is as great as if it cost a fortune. <break time="0.8s" /> Said Scrooge. <break time="0.8s" /> Then Scrooge saw a young woman. <break time="0.8s" /> Named Belle. <break time="0.8s" /> Who had once loved him. <break time="0.8s" /> She said that a golden idol, money. <break time="0.8s" /> Had taken her place in his heart. <break time="0.8s" /> Show me no more. <break time="0.8s" /> Cried Scrooge. <break time="0.8s" /> For he could not bear to watch.
